Cookie Policy & Preferences

Last updated: November 2026

WebServicers ("we", "our", or "us") uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to provide, protect, and improve our services, user portals, and marketing websites. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can exercise control over them.

Categories of Cookies We Use

Essential & Strictly Necessary

Always Active

These cookies are strictly required to provide core website functionality, user authentication, customer session security, CSRF protection, and billing gateway communication.

Analytics & Performance

Optional

Allow us to analyze visitor journeys, calculate page load performance, track error rates, and optimize our digital growth tooling. Data collected is aggregated and anonymized.

Marketing & Ad Attribution

Optional

Used to deliver relevant campaign promotions, measure referral affiliate commissions, and prevent repetitive advertising across external search and social platforms.

How to Manage via Browser Settings

You can configure or delete cookies directly within your web browser settings (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies may prevent access to authenticated customer dashboard areas and checkout workflows.
